children: Shares of Kewaunee Scientific slipped after the maker of laboratory products logged lower sales and profit in the latest quarter.
The stock fell 9.4%, to $31.75, in after-hours trading. Through the close, shares were down 6.4% this year.
The Statesville, N.C., company said sales in the fiscal first quarter fell 6.7%, to $66.3 million.
Profit was $1.7 million, or 58 cents, down from $3.1 million, or $1.04, the year before.
Project-award and release timelines are extended due to broader geopolitical and economic uncertainty, Chief Executive Thomas Hull said.
Sales in the company's lab products segment fell 6.4% due to lower manufacturing volumes. The life-sciences market remains challenged, the company said.
